title: Free effects and typed final interpretation

units.title: Construct: Typed final interpretation and higher-order carrier boundaries
steps: Implement distinct evaluation and rendering dictionaries, borrowed function contexts, staged failures and one shared higher-order program without an interpreter library.

For capture2, the function maps x to x+2, the higher-order term returns5, and rendering is (((lambda x.(x+2)) 1)+2). Evaluation calls its builder at application; rendering calls it at lambda construction.
checks: For capture2, the function maps x to x+2, the higher-order term returns5, and rendering is (((lambda x.(x+2)) 1)+2). Evaluation calls its builder at application; rendering calls it at lambda construction.
Compare exact results, renderings and callback schedules against an independent model; reject incompatible carrier translations and semantic mutation controls.
reasoning: Derive a final-style program as operations over semantic carriers; distinguish integer and integer-function carriers from a universal tagged value and from higher-kind quantification.
Transfer the same term to callback failure and bounded textual output; classify lifetime, purity, arithmetic and type-enforcement limits and produce the13-dimension cost evidence.
deliverables: D1–D4 in X-T69-012: complete all required mechanism, boundary, failure, cost and independent evidence.

Replace the valid builder with one that writes a result then fails, and make rendering run out of text capacity. Derive unchanged publication and preserved callback effects; explain why this does not preserve unconditional cross-interpreter operational equality.

rubric.criterion: Derive a final-style program as operations over semantic carriers; distinguish integer and integer-function carriers from a universal tagged value and from higher-kind quantification.

levels.2: Complete mechanism-specific reasoning, implementation and independently checked bounded evidence.
levels.3: Independent changed-condition implementation with revised ownership, failure and cost arguments.

units.title: Construct: Free effect construction, transactional bind and multiple interpreters
steps: Implement constructors, transactional terminal substitution, a path interpreter and a memoized all-path summary with checked arithmetic and region-lifetime rules.
Emit7(Choose(Pure(-2),Pure(3))) bound through v -> Emit(v,Pure(2*v)) yields trace[7,-2], result-4 for answer0 and trace[7,3], result6 for answer1. Summary is paths2, emissions4, sum2.
checks: Emit7(Choose(Pure(-2),Pure(3))) bound through v -> Emit(v,Pure(2*v)) yields trace[7,-2], result-4 for answer0 and trace[7,3], result6 for answer1. Summary is paths2, emissions4, sum2.
Falsify incorrect substitution and partial publication using independent traces, all bind failure cuts, identity/associativity comparisons and shared-DAG overflow cases.
reasoning: Derive the free Pure/Emit/Choose representation, its finite effect functor and defunctionalized continuation ownership; distinguish arena roots from captured C stacks.

Transfer from one answer path to all paths and finite-resource failure: preserve old roots and outputs, bound recursion/storage, and state the conditions under which monad laws compare meanings rather than allocation traces.
deliverables: D1–D4 in X-T72-010: complete all required mechanism, boundary, failure, cost and independent evidence.

Replace a tree by63 nested choices whose two edges share the same predecessor. Compute2^63 paths in64 nodes without enumerating them; final value0 fits the summary while final value1 overflows signed sum and preserves output. Independently diagnose identity-bind failure at exhausted capacity.

rubric.criterion: Derive the free Pure/Emit/Choose representation, its finite effect functor and defunctionalized continuation ownership; distinguish arena roots from captured C stacks.
